description: Search Simplified Chinese Pokémon TCG (PTCG-CHS) cards across all 245+ products and 24,500+ printings by Chinese name, verified English Pokémon name (e.g. 'Charizard ex', '皮卡丘'), product code (e.g. 'CSV10C', '151C'), collector number, rarity, card type, energy attribute, or series. Call with no filters to list the latest Chinese TCG products.

attribute.description: Filter Pokémon cards by TCG energy type.

collection.description: Filter by collection slug (e.g. 'csv10c'), product code (e.g. 'CSV10C'), or Chinese product name.

limit.description: Maximum number of cards or collections to return (1–50, default: 20).

query.description: Search text matching Chinese card name, verified English Pokémon name, collector number, or illustrator.

name: search_ptcg_chs_cards
title: Search Simplified Chinese PTCG Cards
